melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.spell.label: spellbook_validation_error
melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.spell.role: The build-time 'your graph is broken' error: names each refused spell with its errors and what to change.
responsibilities: surface conjure and meld validation failures with their reasons, by spell name
keep the refused spell objects attached for tooling

melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.spell.label: SpellbookValidationError
melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.spell.role: Exception for refused spells whose message lists each broken spell's errors by name, whole-graph errors, a warning count and internal-error marking.
responsibilities: render the message once at construction from the spells' Phase 4/6 results and the conduit diagnostics handed in through system_diagnostics

show errors, and a spell's gating warnings (GATING_WARNING_CODES: SPELL_CONTRACT_MISSING_PROVIDER, the one Phase 4 gates a lineage on) as its reason when it shows no error; every other warning, and a gating one beside errors, is counted; strategy sources, details payloads and spell ids are never printed (gating reasons, 0.2.8250)

drop exact repeats, a binding-key cycle already reported as CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY, a CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY on a spell that reports SELF_DEPENDENCY, and restating codes (root_not_viable, broken_spell_in_dag) when another error is shown
mark INTERNAL_CODES (Melder bookkeeping checks) as internal errors to report
never raise while rendering; keep broken_spells exactly as supplied
